text:
maria: Quick follow-up after last night's latency spike — proposing two short changes: 1) bump P95 SLO for /v1/generate to 220ms for the next 14d; 2) add request-level throttling when queue depth > 500 to protect core model pools. Thoughts? cc @aj @xiang

aj: Can we go to 230ms instead? tail looked worse than P95. Need per-model breakdown before we lock numbers.

xiang: I'll pull histograms and model-level p95/p99. Also think we should add a dashboard tile for queue depth + p99 tail.

sam: Agree on throttle. On error budgets — we burned ~0.8% of monthly EB for gen service yesterday. Do we reset?

maria: Proposal: one-time EB top-up of +0.5% to avoid immediate cascade of throttles, but gate any deploys with strict canary for 48h. Also annotate the SLO dashboard with incident window.

devops: If we do EB reset we should document it in the playbook and tag the SLO dashboard. I can do the annotation + runbook step.

xiang: Dash link (placeholder): https://dash.redwood.local/d/gen-latency?orgId=1

maria: Owners & timeline suggestion: xiang — histograms + dash widget by EOD tomorrow; aj — throttle rule + config PR by Thu; devops — annotate dashboard + perform EB reset after PR merges; elaine — draft customer comms for enterprise customers.

elaine: :thumbsup: I'll draft a short note focussed on impact, mitigations, and expected timeframe. Non-urgent but want to keep PMs informed.

aj: Throttle should be per-customer token, not global, otherwise big tenants take down the pool. Implement as a soft quota with token bucket + backoff. Example config snippet: ```throttle: { per_tenant: true, queue_threshold: 500, soft_limit_qps: 50 }```

maria: Agreed — per-tenant soft quota behind FF. We'll default to conservative limits and ramp.

devops: I'll schedule the EB reset as a one-time +0.5% after the throttle PR is deployed. Plan to run it 0900 PT Fri and note in incident log. Also adding a checklist: annotate SLO -> run EB reset -> postmortem links -> tickets.

sam: Can we add an automated alert when queue > 300 to give ops time to intervene before hitting 500?

xiang: Yup, adding alert: query looks at sum(queue_depth) by pool > 300 sustained 5m -> alert. Also will add 15m rolling window for p99 regression.

maria: Quick recap of actionable items (I will follow up in weekly SLO sync):
- xiang: histograms + dashboard widget (due: 1723590000)
- aj: throttle PR (per-tenant) + config (due: 1723660000)
- devops: annotate SLO dashboard + execute EB reset + add playbook step (due: 1723720000)
- elaine: draft enterprise customer note (due: 1723730000)
- sam: verify alert thresholds + escalation rules (collab with xiang)

maria: If no major objections by EOD I'll file a short RFC and patch the SLO sheet. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:

sre-bot: Incident tag applied: latency-spike-1723507200. Notified oncall rotation.
